project.name: Tell Me What Changed
project.goal: Every week, tell me what changed in PYTHON'S RELEASE NOTES AND MAJOR WEB-FRAMEWORK RELEASES that actually matters to me, and nothing else. Replace that with what I depend on before planning. The rule that makes this worth reading: report changes, not activity. A release that does not affect me gets one line or no line; a deprecation that will break something I use gets the version it lands in, what breaks, and what to do. Every item carries its date and a link to the primary source — the changelog, the release, the spec, the announcement — never a summary of a summary. Say explicitly when nothing important changed; a quiet week reported as quiet is the most valuable brief you will send, and padding it is how I learn to stop reading. Keep a running file of what you have already told me so you never report the same change twice.
